instruction_text:
concise, clear, landing naturally as a settled conclusion; not flat, not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: A word gotcha makes rare words the prize, though common words are usually better to learn first. Rarity shows how often a word is used, not what learners should study first. The game alone cannot show if players will open more packs than learn words by heart.
